title: Supplier assessments and treatment of supply chain findings need evidence
remediation: The deployment supplier assurance lead and component maintainers identify in-scope suppliers, delivered components and services, reviewers and assessment cadence. Review a representative supplier against approved requirements. Record the finding, selected safeguards in the supply chain or system plans, corrective action owner, follow-up and disposition. Use G10 for scoped root dependency safeguards and G77 for the supply chain risk assessment.

milestones.title: Collect a dated supplier review, selected control references, and a sampled weakness through treatment and follow-up
